description: Hand-read image marks for the spjass TikTok (references/shots/spjass-tiktok.mp4). Pixel coordinates in the decoded frame (576 x 1024 px, u right, v down). Only take 1 (frames 66-145, fixed top-down camera, goal.E at the top) is calibrated. Every mark was read on a gridded, enlarged crop of the named frame; uncertainty_px is the reading uncertainty (blur, perspective of the slot ends), not a model error. Status of every mark: traced.
read_by: AI (2026-10-06), not reviewed by the user
orientation_check: The ice sponsor text (BYGGMAX, gyproc) appears rotated 180 deg, not mirrored, and the intro close-up's board ads (GP Batteries, TAKTIK) read normally: take 1 is an unmirrored top-down view; image up = +x (toward goal.E), image left = +y.

camera_correspondences.note: Ice-plane points: where slots cross the painted blue and goal lines (line centre x slot centreline), and slot ends (centre of the rounded end). World positions from data/geometry.json fixture paths and the board landmarks via map.overhead.preview. The recorded table is another STIGA edition (Byggmax/gyproc artwork); identical line/slot layout is an assumption checked only by the fit residuals.

blade_toe_marks.note: End of the W-C stick (blade toe, on the ice) per frame, read on 3x crops. Frames 123, 129-132 are motion-blurred and not read. The model blade lies along the figure's local +y (toe at local [2.38, 43.47] mm), so the toe position fixes the pose once the pivot is constrained to the W-C slot.
blade_toe_marks.visual_heading_note: rough heading read from the stick direction (biased: the shaft rises toward the hands); used only to choose between the two slot solutions of a toe mark

qualitative_evidence.view: intro close-up from behind the centre (not calibrated)
qualitative_evidence.reading: W-C faces the camera with the puck hidden behind it (goal side); it turns, the puck appears at its +y side (33-36), then the puck leaves forward and enters the +y side of the net (37-38) while W-C faces the goal with the number 26 on its back.

qualitative_evidence.view: slow manual demonstration, same camera as take 1
qualitative_evidence.reading: the puck at W-C's +y side; the presenter turns the figure clockwise (stick up 796, right 808-826, down 844-856, down-left 862-880) until the blade lies behind the puck (its -x side): the clockwise spin that brings the blade behind the puck before the shot.

qualitative_evidence.view: full-speed repetition from a wider top-down camera (not calibrated)
qualitative_evidence.reading: same sequence: puck behind the back, turn, puck to the +y side, spin, puck into the +y side of the net (933-936).

qualitative_evidence.view: presenter explaining with a hand (same camera as take 1)
qualitative_evidence.reading: points at the puck on the slot line behind the centre and at the stick; turns the figure through several positions. The spoken explanation (audio) was not transcribed: speech recognition is not available in this environment.

goalie_blade_mark.note: E-G stick blade (tan, on the ice) read on a 4x crop of frame 100; the goalie stays still in take 1 (frames 66-140). Pose from the blade (heading from heel->toe, pivot = heel - R heel_local) as in iteration 22.
